structured.rankingRationale: Top ranking favors Nyon/La Côte events with explicit participant accommodation or hotel-booking signals, then airport-corridor events with explicit housing or expo mechanisms. Confirmed incumbent venues are penalized for current-edition accessibility; Lausanne events rank lower because transfer relevance is unproven.
notesForDeepResearch: Prioritize GDPM and OENOVITI for La Côte lodging verification.
Treat Palexpo-scale events as competitive market intelligence unless overflow or alternative-hotel process is evidenced.
For FER and SET’UP test day-meeting, catering and relationship-development value rather than room blocks.
materialUncertainties: No candidate has a published YOTEL room block or peak-room requirement.

Confirmed Palexpo, Hilton, university and training-centre venues are not open hotel inventory; current-edition opportunity is limited to overflow, side events, supplier relationships or future capture.
Lausanne candidates require evidence of airport-corridor lodging or transport demand.
